sentences.text: Let God hold you.
Say these words with me quietly, as you rest.
The Lord is my healer.
He binds up my wounds.
I am not alone in this bed.
My body, my heart and my mind are in his hands.
I will rest tonight, and he will renew me.
I laid me down and slept;
I awaked;
for the LORD sustained me.

I awaked;
for the Lord sustained me.
Sleep itself is an act of trust.
You let go of control for hours, and God keeps your heart beating and your lungs breathing.
Tonight, he will sustain you again.

sentences.text: I do not have to hide them from you.
Bind up these wounds, Lord, the way only you can.
But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities:
the chastisement of our peace was upon him;
and with his stripes we are healed.
Before Jesus ever healed anyone, he chose to be wounded himself.
He knows pain from the inside.
So when you bring him your pain tonight, you are not bringing it to someone distant.
You are bringing it to someone who understands.

sentences.text: You can let go.
He will not.
Be careful for nothing;
but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
The peace of God shall keep your heart and mind, like a guard at the door.
Whatever news tomorrow brings, tonight that peace stands watch over you.

sentences.text: I give you every what if.
Replace my fear with your peace, and let my mind rest in you tonight.
Lord, I pray for every mind that is tired and heavy tonight.
For depression that makes mornings hard.
For anxiety that tightens the chest.
For thoughts that feel too dark to say out loud.
Bring light into those places.
Lead each person to the help they need, the friend, the counsellor, the doctor, and let them never feel ashamed to ask.
Be still, and know that I am God.

sentences.text: Let your eyes close.
Let your shoulders drop.
Let your arms rest heavy at your sides.
Let your hands open.
Feel the mattress holding you, the pillow supporting your head.
You do not have to hold yourself up tonight.
You are held.
Let the warmth of rest spread slowly through your chest, your stomach, your hips, your legs, all the way down to your feet.
Every part of you is known by the God who made you.
Every cell is in his care.
Rest now.

sentences.text: You do not need the right words.
You only need to bring yourself to the One who heals.
So let us pray.
Lord, here I am at the end of this day, with my body and my heart just as they are.
You know every ache, every symptom, every fear I have not said out loud.
Heal me, O Lord.
Hold me tonight.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
The same psalm says God counts the stars and calls them all by name.
And yet he bends down to bind up wounds, like a nurse tending a bandage.
The God of the galaxies is gentle with your hurt tonight.
